lines: 我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。
我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。
Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage .

Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage .
Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
Your rules have been melodies to me
while I have been living in strange lands.

遵守你的律法。
耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，
遵守你的律法。

O LORD
in the night
and have kept thy law .

O LORD
in the night
and have kept thy law .
I have remembered your name
LORD
in the night
and I obey your law.
I have given thought to your name in the night
O Lord
and have kept your law.
耶和华是我的福分；
我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
耶和華是我的福分；
我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
Thou art my portion
O LORD : I have said that I would keep thy words .

我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。

我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
Thou art my portion
O LORD : I have said that I would keep thy words .
The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
The Lord is my heritage: I have said that I would be ruled by your words.
我一心求过你的恩；
愿你照你的话怜悯我！
我一心求過你的恩；
願你照你的話憐憫我！
I intreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .

愿你照你的话怜悯我！

願你照你的話憐憫我！
I intreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .
I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me
as you have said.
我思想我所行的道，
就转步归向你的法度。
我思想我所行的道，
就轉步歸向你的法度。

and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .

I thought on my ways
and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .
I considered my ways
and turned my steps to your statutes.
I gave thought to my steps
and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.
我急忙遵守你的命令，
并不迟延。
我急忙遵守你的命令，
並不遲延。
I made haste
and delayed not to keep thy commandments .

並不遲延。
I made haste
and delayed not to keep thy commandments .
I will hurry
and not delay
to obey your commandments.
I was quick to do your orders
and let no time be wasted.

我却没有忘记你的律法。
惡人的繩索纏繞我，
我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law .

The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law .
The ropes of the wicked bind me
but I won’t forget your law.
The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.
我因你公义的典章，
半夜必起来称谢你。
我因你公義的典章，
半夜必起來稱謝你。
At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .

At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you
because of your righteous ordinances.
In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise
because of all your right decisions.
凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，
我都与他作伴。
凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，

I am a companion of all them that fear thee
and of them that keep thy precepts .

and of them that keep thy precepts .
I am a friend of all those who fear you
of those who observe your precepts.
I keep company with all your worshippers
and those who have your orders in their memory.

求你将你的律例教训我！
耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；
求你將你的律例教訓我！
The earth
O LORD
is full of thy mercy : teach me thy statutes .

O LORD
is full of thy mercy : teach me thy statutes .
The earth is full of your loving kindness
LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
The earth
O Lord
is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules.

Thou hast dealt well with thy servant
O LORD
according unto thy word .

O LORD
according unto thy word .
You have treated your servant well
according to your word
LORD.
You have done good to your servant
O Lord
in keeping with your word.
求你将精明和知识赐给我，
因我信了你的命令。
求你將精明和知識賜給我，

Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .

Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
Teach me good judgment and knowledge
for I believe in your commandments.
Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.

现在却遵守你的话。
我未受苦以先走迷了路，
現在卻遵守你的話。

Before I was afflicted
I went astray; but now I observe your word.
Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.

求你将你的律例教训我！
你本為善，所行的也善；
求你將你的律例教訓我！
Thou art good
and doest good ; teach me thy statutes .

and do good. Teach me your statutes.
You are good
and your works are good; give me knowledge of your rules.
